QuestInfo.name: Aurora's Gate
QuestInfo.0: Your preparations are done. It is time to return home!
QuestInfo.1: Use the #i2430873# #bVampiric Lantern#k to get to Harmony.
QuestInfo.2: When you reached Harmony, you found your old friend and fellow mage Vieren. He became a spirit of light in the centuries since you saw him. What happened?

0.0: The four energies are responding! The way to Harmony should open soon.
0.1: Home is finally in reach. All I need do is use the Vampiric Lantern.

no.0: I shouldn't dawdle. If I don't use the Vampiric Lantern quickly, I may miss my chance!

0.msg: You're here! You're here! Happy day! I knew I'd see you again!\r\n#L0##bVieren? Is it really you?#l\n#k

1.msg: In the flesh! Well, not literally, but it's still me!
